primitives.name: Self-Exclusion Access Control Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Session-establishment points (where an exclusion check must run) The gate must be checked on **every** authenticated request, so the cheap place is the session object (set once in `lib/auth.ts:68`) read everywhere via `auth()`.
primitives.assumptions: (1) Self-exclusion state is stored in the session object; (2) Expiration timestamps are monotonically increasing; (3) Owner privileges override all exclusions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Discrete jump at t = t_{\text{expire}}^{\text{SE}}, where the access control flips from allowed (1) to forbidden (0).

layer2.mapping: Maps to a binary eligibility filter in GSI/GSE, where the system state transitions between 'active' and 'blocked' based on the exclusion flag.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of denied requests per time interval, logged as \mathcal{G}_{\text{SE}}(t)=0 events.

primitives.name: Age Attestation Verification Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: This is where a first-time user is cheapest to gate.
primitives.assumptions: (1) Age attestation occurs during account creation; (2) Once attested, the state is immutable; (3) The gate operates independently of other compliance checks.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Binary switch at the moment of attestation, transitioning the user's eligibility from unverified (0) to verified (1).

layer2.mapping: Corresponds to a data-validation checkpoint in GSI/GSE, ensuring that only compliant users proceed through the registration funnel.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of new registrations that pass age attestation, tracked as \mathcal{G}_{\text{AA}}(u)=1.

primitives.name: Payment Authorization Proxy Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: A blocked user must get a 403 with the responsible-play messaging, not a Stripe error.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{P}': 'Proxy authorization predicate (dimensionless)', '\\mathcal{G}_{\\text{SE}}': 'Self-exclusion gate indicator (dimensionless)', '\\mathcal{G}_{\\text{AA}}': 'Age attestation gate indicator (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: (1) Both gates are independent; (2) The logical AND enforces mandatory compliance; (3) Payment processing is deferred until both conditions are met.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure mode occurs when either gate returns 0, resulting in a hard rejection of the payment attempt.

layer2.mapping: Represents a composite eligibility check in GSI/GSE, where the transaction state transitions to 'denied' if any compliance rule is violated.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of authorized vs. denied checkout attempts, measured as \mathcal{P}=0 events.

The checkout proxy combines these via logical conjunction, ensuring that only users who satisfy both criteria can initiate financial transactions.
